context: Tests whether the agent follows the correct merge command with the right flags, uses safe git pull semantics post-merge, properly cleans up local and remote branch refs, and performs the required post-merge verification steps including confirming the publish workflow was triggered.

checklist.name: Merge flags: --merge
checklist.description: Uses `gh pr merge` with the `--merge` flag (not `--squash` or `--rebase`)

checklist.name: Merge flags: --delete-branch
checklist.description: Uses `gh pr merge` with the `--delete-branch` flag to delete the remote branch on merge

checklist.name: Fast-forward only pull
checklist.description: After switching to main, uses `git pull --ff-only` (not plain `git pull` or `git pull --rebase`)

checklist.name: Checkout main first
checklist.description: Switches to the main branch (`git checkout main`) before running `git pull`

checklist.name: Local branch deletion
checklist.description: Deletes the local feature branch with `git branch -d` (not force-delete `-D`)

checklist.name: Remote ref pruning
checklist.description: Runs `git remote prune origin` to clean up stale remote-tracking refs

checklist.name: Verify merge on main
checklist.description: Includes a step to verify the merged commit is present on the main branch (e.g. `git log`, `gh pr view`, or checking PR status)

checklist.name: Publish CI check
checklist.description: Includes a step to check that the publish/release CI workflow was triggered after the merge (e.g. checking workflow runs)

checklist.name: Report merged PR URL
checklist.description: Script or documentation includes reporting the merged PR URL as part of the outcome summary

checklist.name: Pre-merge: CI green gate
checklist.description: Script or checklist requires confirming CI is green before merging — does not proceed with merge if CI is failing
